comments.text: Lucia is paradise for tourists, yet locals can struggle with water shortages. Is this really the paradise we should dream of ?

comments.author: @TravelBeyond4K
comments.text: Those majestic Pitons rising straight out of the turquoise ocean are absolute perfection! St. Lucia truly has the most unreal, dramatic tropical scenery on the planet. Walking through those lush green rainforests feels like stepping into complete paradise!

comments.author: @OrlandoCoombs-i4t
comments.text: A lot of Caribbean nations need to evolve. They have to expand their economic landscape beyond tourism. They need to upgrade infrastructure, become more tech savvy, and engage in more international trade. They need to develop new industries and prepare their youth to compete globally. Young people need to finish high school and be able to get jobs at home that pay a living wage, they need to be college educated at ST LUCIA's Universities and become successful, well paid, highly educated professionals who live and work in ST LUCIA. The same thing with Jamaica, Haiti, The Bahamas, Turks and Caicos, and others.

comments.author: @OrlandoCoombs-i4t
comments.text: A visit is very different from a permanent stay.

comments.author: @CelebrityStories6868
comments.text: Stunning 4K footage? More like 4K DELUSION! They show you luxury resorts and crystal-clear waters, but completely CUT OUT the extreme poverty, skyrocketing crime, and locals who can't even afford basic groceries. Stop selling us a fake fairytale!
